genre.zh: 南法小酒館美食雜誌（Bon Appétit 那種）
genre.en: a Provençal bistro feature in the manner of Bon Appétit: the real dining room, wine and bread on the table, late-afternoon sun

s: the plate on a linen-covered table on a terrace, hard late Provence-style sun from one side, a glass of white wine casting a long amber shadow
shot from directly overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: two hands with knife and fork poised over the plate, hard sun with crisp shadows

the box leans tall against a terracotta-orange kitchen tile backsplash, filling most of the frame, with a plated serving of the finished gnocchi in green pistou and seared sea bass sitting right beside it, hard morning sun from a window at the left throwing the box's sharp shadow across the tile and the countertop

the box stands upright on a worn oak dining table in a home kitchen against a deep sea-blue painted wall, large in the foreground, a steaming plate of the cooked gnocchi with pistou and golden sea bass pieces next to it and a fork resting on the rim, a single hard side light from a window on the right casting a long clean shadow of the box across the wood

the box sits on a mint-green tiled bathroom-style kitchen counter beside a cooked bowl of green pistou gnocchi topped with seared sea bass, a hard beam of afternoon sun from the upper left slicing across both and drawing crisp edges of shadow on the mint tile

the box is propped on a sunlit apartment balcony table against a tomato-red wall, huge in frame, the finished plate of pesto gnocchi with sea bass beside it and a glass of white wine, hard low sun from the right throwing the box's shadow and the plate's shadow long across the weathered table

the box rests on a butcher-block counter in a small home kitchen against a deep sea-blue tile wall, a pan of freshly cooked gnocchi and flaked sea bass in bright green pistou set next to it on a trivet, hard overhead window light from behind-left leaving a strong dark shadow on the wood
